messages.author: 0b90650d0b406a85
messages.subject: knit errors
parts:
I am on OSX (10.7.3) and use R 2.1.4 and all of my packages are up to
date. My Latex install came from MikeTex and I do have the framed
package.

I frequently see this error: http://i.imgur.com/evQds.png


I do have the framed package installed (http://i.imgur.com/aomVl.png).
What am I doing wrong?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knit errors
parts:
One common problem on Mac is LaTeX is not in PATH. Can you run this in
your terminal?

which pdflatex

If it does not give you the path to pdflatex, this should be the
reason why knit2pdf() failed.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] knit errors
parts:
OK, then can you just compile the tex output under ~/Desktop/ in the terminal:

pdflatex test.tex

If this gives you the expected PDF document test.pdf, it might be the
problem of R: it cannot find pdflatex; framed.sty should not be
relevant here. I do not use Mac, so it is not convenient for me to
test the code; I remember the tikzDevice package does a good search
for LaTeX under Mac, and I may go to their code to see how to support
Mac better.

Or if you use the latest version on GitHub
(https://github.com/yihui/knitr), you will see knit2pdf() has got a
new argument 'compiler', so you can run

knit2pdf('test.Rnw', compiler = '/usr/texbin/pdflatex')

Regards,
